tool.name: nf-core interproscan
tool.description: Produces protein annotations and predictions from an amino acids FASTA file
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ if [ -d 'data' ]; then # Find interproscan.properties to link data/ from work directory INTERPROSCAN_DIR="\$( dirname "\$( dirname "\$( which interproscan.sh )" )" )" INTERPROSCAN_PROPERTIES="\$( find "\$INTERPROSCAN_DIR/share" -name "interproscan.properties" )" cp "\$INTERPROSCAN_PROPERTIES" . sed -i "/^bin\\.directory=/ s|.*|bin.directory=\$INTERPROSCAN_DIR/bin|" interproscan.properties export INTERPROSCAN_CONF=interproscan.properties fi # else use sample DB included with conda ( testing only! )
if ${is_compressed} ; then gzip -c -d ${fasta} > ${fasta_name} fi
interproscan.sh \\ --cpu ${task.cpus} \\ --input ${fasta_name} \\ ${args} \\ --output-file-base ${prefix}
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": interproscan: \$( interproscan.sh --version | sed '1!d; s/.*version //' ) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Produces protein annotations and predictions from an amino acids FASTA file
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: interproscan Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/interproscan ]]>
